services.name: Shell Island Snorkel Cruise on the "Island Time" Catamaran
services.desc: The “Shell Island Snorkel & Dolphin Cruise” is approximately 3 hours of fun in the sun! 3 Hours About First you'll cruise to the beautiful St. Andrews Bay where we will find the day’s best spot based on conditions and clarity. The boat will anchor in approximately 5 feet of water where you can snorkel for seashells and catch a glimpse of the underwater world, learn about local sea-life, or just relax and float while you take in the sun. You can also wade through the shallow water onto Shell Island to hunt for shells or try out the stand-up paddleboards. policies: Cancellations: -There is a 72 hour cancellation notice required for any reason other than weather.
Island Time captain reserves the right to cancel due to inclement weather.
If you or anyone in your group does not show up/misses the boat, you will not receive a refund and will not be eligible to reschedule.
All cruises are subject to cancel due to capacity minimums.
INCLEMENT WEATHER POLICY If it seems a storm is approaching, the crew and office staff keep watch on the radar and discuss options.
If you are nervous about inclement weather you can cancel and reschedule at any time, but cancelling the cruise is usually a last minute decision.
No coolers or outside food and beverages allowed on catamaran tours
